def transform5(grid):
    g=tuple(map(tuple,grid)); h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v]
    c1=cells[0][0] and None
    colors=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v and v not in colors: colors.append(v)
    cA,cB=colors
    A=[(i,j) for i,j in cells if g[i][j]==cA]; B=[(i,j) for i,j in cells if g[i][j]==cB]
    ri=[i for i,_ in A]; ci=[j for _,j in A]
    i0,i1,L,R=min(ri),max(ri),min(ci),max(ci)
    w_=R-L+1
    # B relative to A bounding box
    bj=[j for _,j in B]; bi=[i for i,_ in B]
    bL,bR,bT=min(bj),max(bj),min(bi)
    out=[list(r) for r in g]
    # erase B
    for i,j in B: out[i][j]=0
    if bL < L:   # B to the left -> vmirror placed left
        for i in range(i0,i1+1):
            row=g[i]
            for j in range(L,R+1):
                if row[j]: out[i][2*L-1-j]=g[i][j]
    elif bR > R: # right
        for i in range(i0,i1+1):
            row=g[i]
            for j in range(L,R+1):
                if row[j]: out[i][2*R+1-j]=g[i][j]
    else:        # below -> vflip below
        for k in range(i1+1, min(i1+(i1-i0+1), h)):
            src=g[i1-(k-(i1+1))-0] # row index i1 - (k-i1-1)
            out[k]=list(g[i1-(k-i1-1)])
    return out
